STAYS estimate AND NEWS: ON PURPOSE, per the honesty rule in docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md: EDGAR corroborates the WINDOW, not the day, and KB Home files no 8-K for its earnings-date announcements, so no primary pins 09-22. notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research 2026-09-16, after reading in full the single proposal carrying this id (proposals/kb-home-q3-fy2026-2026-09-22.from-lennar-q3-fy2026-2026-09-16.json, filed by the Lennar lane the same day). That inversion is the event's real value — it is the sector's cleanest attribution window, sitting two days ahead of new-home-sales-2026-09-24 (confirmed) and seven ahead of case-shiller-hpi-2026-09-29 (estimate). (3) SYMBOLS keeps ["KBH"] for the reason the proposal gave — one builder's print is not market-wide and [] would leave every future deterministic screen with no price to diff.
